name: montar-versao
description: Prepares the next NectarCRM bugfix release (pom bump on alpha, the version in the YouTrack Versão field, the ready-to-test backend tickets of WEB/IN in it — from every project with an alpha or homolog branch that ships on Monday, asking when unsure — and the release ticket for infra) and builds it: a main version (pom bump on top of alpha, tag vYY.Q.NNN) or a hotfix (vYY.Q.NNN.H) that starts from the latest version or hotfix and cherry-picks only the chosen commits — including fixes made on the PR after review — instead of the whole alpha. Pushes the tag (and the hotfix branch); the main version bump goes to alpha with the tag. Services released alongside get the CRM tag (no pom bump).
